title: Secondary school

questions.question: Do you remember your first day at secondary school?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do. It was when I was about twelve, and I remember feeling nervous because everything was new. What struck me most was how big the school was compared to primary school.

questions.question: Were there any subjects you found difficult at secondary school?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, there were. I found maths quite difficult, especially the algebra part. I remember staying after class for extra help, and eventually I managed to catch up.

questions.question: What was your favorite subject at secondary school?
questions.sampleAnswer: If I had to pick one, I’d say history, because I love the stories behind real events. It’s like a great movie that actually happened, and that’s what made it my favourite.

questions.question: Is there anything you miss about your secondary school?
questions.sampleAnswer: Yes, I do miss it. I can still remember the lively classroom discussions and my friends at lunchtime. What I miss most is the simple feeling of being together every day.
